headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 20, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a shutout victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Sean Burke pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball. The Los Angeles Dodgers also secured a win, with Yoshinobu Yamamoto pitching a complete game against the New York Yankees. Meanwhile, the Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 6-1 victory.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Will Vest being transferred to the 60-day injured list due to right posterior elbow inflammation. Other players, including PJ Poulin, Richard Lovelady, Ryan Helsley, Stephen Kolek, Justin Sterner, Lourdes Gurriel Jr., and Jeff Criswell, have been placed on the injured list with various injuries.

There have been several trades and roster movements, with the Chicago Cubs acquiring Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for Aiden Moffett. The Baltimore Orioles acquired Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals for cash, while the Washington Nationals traded Robert Hassell III to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash.

top_news.title: **White Sox Shut Out Blue Jays 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a shutout victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Sean Burke pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball, striking out 5 and allowing just 2 hits. Grant Taylor earned the save in the win.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Take Down Yankees 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured an 8-2 victory over the New York Yankees, with Yoshinobu Yamamoto pitching a complete game, allowing 2 ER and striking out 7 batters. Trent Grisham led the Dodgers' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Fall Short in Bronx**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers suffered a 1-2 loss to the New York Yankees, with Tommy Edman leading the Dodgers' offense with 1 hit, 1 home run, and 1 RBI. Alex Vesia pitched a strong 1.0 inning, striking out 3 batters without allowing a run or walk.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Red Sox in 6-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 6-1 victory. Willson Contreras led the Rays' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Vest Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers right-handed pitcher Will Vest has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right posterior elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Aaron Civale in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett. Civale joins the Cubs' roster following the trade.
